verdict.rationale: Poke's Recipes let users build and share their own set-ups. A recipe bundles MCP tools and data sources, can specify required user context (inputContext) and a prefilled first message, and gets a share link, QR code and marketplace listing when published. However, these are integration and automation configurations layered onto the single Poke assistant, not distinct custom assistants with their own persistent instructions and knowledge base. Missing for 10: separately named custom assistants or personas, a per-assistant system-instruction field, uploaded knowledge or documents beyond MCP data sources, and independent hands-on corroboration.
